live.meaning: Authoritative source is currently expected to resolve.

transient-outage.meaning: Temporary availability failure; do not alter provenance claims.

moved.meaning: Authoritative source moved to a replacement endpoint.

permanently-unavailable.meaning: Authoritative source is no longer available and no replacement is known.

legal-withdrawal.meaning: Source or access was withdrawn for legal, licensing, privacy, or provider-policy reasons.

preservation.source_bytes: only when separately permitted by committed redistribution evidence
preservation.restricted_or_withdrawn_bytes: never preserve merely to defeat upstream withdrawal
